essence: The Goddess both creates and joyfully abides in the refuge of Bhairava.
The Goddess both defines and upholds the refuge of Bhairava.
The Goddess both dwells in and bestows the blissful awareness of Bhairava.
The Goddess both creates and augments the sovereignty of Bhairavi.
The Goddess rules over and embodies the sovereignty of Bhairavi.
